systems.system: Government Service Centers (Decent Life first phase)
systems.owner: Ministry of Planning and Economic Development reports it; operator not stated
systems.tiers: 305 centres completed of 332 targeted in the first-phase villages of 20 governorates by the end of 2022/2023; each includes a local unit, post office, supply office, real estate registry, social unit and civil registry

systems.system: Fibre optic network to Decent Life villages
systems.tiers: 187 villages connected of 1,468 targeted by the end of 2022/2023

note: Buildings and connectivity only: the service centres are said to house a civil registry, with nothing on how a birth or death is registered there.
